name: llf
description: Long Live Food (Ad Council food waste campaign) monorepo

scripts.dev: pnpm db:up && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/ensure-cms-env.mjs && concurrently -k -n web,tool,cms -c cyan,magenta,yellow "pnpm --filter @llf/web dev" "pnpm --filter @llf/find-my-tips dev" "pnpm --filter @llf/cms dev"
scripts.dev:cms: pnpm db:up && node --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/ensure-cms-env.mjs && pnpm --filter @llf/cms dev
